import.description:
## Import of creditor invoices
Here you can import creditor invoices in CSV format (.csv) from Datev.

headerOnly.newInvoicesSkipped: New invoices cannot be created using this file. Please use the import with invoice positions. {arg0} new invoice(s) will be ignored.

import.templateInfo:
## Description:
- These files are generated by DATEV.
- The import takes place in two steps, both of which must be carried out consecutively for **new** invoices.
- The invoices or invoice positions can be re-imported independently at any time to update the data.
- ProjectForge automatically detects whether invoices or positions are being imported.
- It is best to export for **individual months**.
- After uploading a file, the import file can be compared with the ProjectForge invoices and then you can select which invoices/positions should be imported.

**Step 1: Import invoice positions** (required for **new** invoices)
- The files are created in Datev via "Belegdaten exportieren" -> "Rechnungseingang exportieren" (files end with **"Lieferantenrechnungen.csv"**).
- This import is used to create new invoices and to update invoices (with positions).
- Invoices and positions no longer included in the import can also be deleted.
- Supported columns: "Periode", "Betrag", "Währung", "Datum", "RENR", "LieferantName", "LieferantKonto", "Ware/Leistung", "Fällig_am", "Steuer%", "KOST1", "KOST2"

**Step 2: Update invoice information** (optional)
- In Datev, select the desired month as the period in the "Belegübersicht" and generate the file (files end with **"export.csv"**).
- This import only updates the header data of existing invoices (payment date, etc.) without changing the positions.
- Invoices no longer included in the import can also be deleted if desired.
- Supported columns: "Geschäftspartner-Name", "Geschäftspartner-Konto", "WKZ", "Rechnungs-Nr.", "Rechnungsdatum", "Konto", "Ware/Leistung", "BezahltAm", "Fällig mit Skonto 1", "Skonto 1 in %", "Fällig ohne Skonto", "IBAN", "BIC", "Notiz"

help.attributes: **Attributes:** `id` names the report (shown as column head and in the path), `title` describes it. Without `suppressOther="true"` the accounting records of a report that match none of its children are shown as additional column `<id> - Other`; without `suppressDuplicates="true"` the records matching more than one child are shown as column `<id> - Duplicates`. Both columns help to check that the children are complete and free of overlaps.
help.drilldown: **Drill-down:** A column head shown as link opens the report of this child objective with its own children as columns; the path above the table leads back. The amounts and the icon next to a column head open the accounting records behind it (requires the right for the DATEV import).
help.example:
```xml
<ReportObjective title="Customer ACME" id="ACME" suppressOther="true" suppressDuplicates="true">
  <kost1-include>3.*</kost1-include>
  <kost1-exclude>*.01</kost1-exclude>
  <kost2-include>5.*</kost2-include>
  <kost2-exclude>*.02</kost2-exclude>
  <ReportObjective title="Project ACME-WEB-Portal" id="ACME-WEB-Portal">
    <kost2-include>5.020.01.*</kost2-include>
  </ReportObjective>
  <ReportObjective title="Project ACME-Java-Migration" id="ACME-Java-Migration">
    <kost2-include>5.020.02.*</kost2-include>
  </ReportObjective>
</ReportObjective>
```
help.intro: A report objective is an XML file describing a tree of reports. Each report selects accounting records by their cost 1 and cost 2 units; nested report objectives refine the selection of their parent.
help.rules:
**Selection rules:**
- An empty include list matches all records.
- A non-empty include list requires at least one of its entries to match.
- With several include lists (cost 1 and cost 2) a record must match all of them.
- A record matching any entry of an exclude list is excluded.
- A nested report objective can only select records of its parent (always a subset).
help.storage: The uploaded report objectives are kept in memory until logout or server restart. Use "Clear" to load other ones.
help.title: Format of the report objectives
help.wildcards: **Expressions:** The entries are Java regular expressions (`java.util.regex.Pattern`) matched against the formatted cost unit (e.g. `5.020.01.03`). For convenience every `.` is escaped and `*` stands for any characters: `3.*` matches everything starting with "3.", `*.02` everything ending with ".02". An expression starting with an apostrophe is used as it is (without the apostrophe), e.g. `'^5\.510.*`.

hint.create: Prepares a cancellation invoice for this invoice: its positions are taken over with negative amounts and opened as a new, not yet saved invoice. This invoice is only cancelled once the cancellation invoice is saved; if it is not saved, nothing changes.
hint.original: This invoice is cancelled by the cancellation invoice {arg0} and was therefore automatically set to "cancelled". To undo the cancellation, delete the cancellation invoice: this invoice then gets back the status "issued" or "paid".
hint.system: A cancellation invoice fully reverses the cancelled invoice: it takes over its positions with negative amounts and has no number of its own, but the one of the cancelled invoice with the suffix "-S". On saving, the cancelled invoice is automatically set to "cancelled". Type and cancelled invoice cannot be changed afterwards; if the cancellation invoice is deleted, the cancelled invoice gets back the status "issued" or "paid". Please note: the amounts of the cancellation invoice are automatically set to negative values – so please do not change the amounts!
hint.unsaved: This cancellation invoice is only prepared and not yet in effect: the invoice is only cancelled once you save this cancellation invoice. Without saving, nothing happens.

lucene.link: Link to howto of lucene queries.

authentification.info:
A second factor is required for proceeding.

Please enter any 2nd factor (e.g. OTP) you have (requested): from Your Authenticator-App or received by SMS or mail or you may use any WebAuthn token you have registered.

code.info: Code from your authenticator app or the one time password (OTP) you received by e-mail of text message.

timePenalty.message: You have been blocked until {arg0} ({arg1}) after {arg2} failed code checks. Please note, that your account might be deactivated after {arg3} failed OTP checks.

error.validation: Code not correct or two-factor authentication not configured.

password.info: The password is only needed as an additional factor if you received the code via e-mail.

mail.info: Send code as e-mail. The code will be valid up to 2 minutes and your password is required when validating the sent code.
mail.sentSuccessfully: Mail was successfully sent to Your e-mail address at {arg0}
mail.title: Message from ProjectForge

sms.info: Request code as text message to your mobile phone. The code will be valid up to 2 minutes.
sms.sentSuccessfully: Message successfully sent to Your mobile phone at {arg0}.

authenticator_key.tooltip: This authentication token is usable for Authenticator clients for Two-factor-authentication with e.g. Microsoft-, Google-authenticator app, or Fortitoken.

calendar_rest.tooltip: This authentication token is usable ical exports of calendars and the user's time sheets.

dav_token.tooltip: This authentication token is usable the CalDAV/CardDAV functionality of ProjectForge.

rest_client.tooltip: This authentication token is usable for rest clients if ProjectForge's password shouldn't be used there.

jiraUsername.tooltip: Only needed, if the ProjectForge user name differs from the JIRA user name and the user want to work with JIRA inside ProjectForge.

localUser.tooltip: Local users will not be synchronized with an external user management system (such as LDAP).

mobilePhone.info:
Mobile phone usable as a 2nd factor (required e.g. for password reset or other services).

You may configure this field by any admin or by configuring your two-factor-authentication.

tooltip.content:
Define here your personal phone id's in your company (id = internal phone number). Multiple values should be comma separated.

In address list you can choose your current phone for direct dialing by clicking on a phone number in the address list.

restrictedUser.tooltip: A restricted user has only the ability to log-in and to change his password, but the user is synchronized with the external user management system.

halfDayEnd._: Half leave day at last day

vacation.plandannualleave: Number of planned leave days for the rest of the year

special.tooltip: Special leave days will be excluded from the vacation account.
